description:
Make confident choices about what you feed your pets.

PetScans instantly analyzes pet food ingredients to identify potentially harmful substances, allergens, and questionable additives. Simply scan a barcode or take a photo of the ingredient label.

KEY FEATURES:

• Instant Barcode Scanning
Scan any pet food product barcode to get detailed safety analysis

• Photo Ingredient Analysis
Take a photo of ingredient labels for products not in our database

• Personalized Alerts
Create profiles for each pet with their specific allergens and sensitivities

• Dual Safety Scoring
Get both general safety scores and pet-specific suitability ratings

• Science-Based Analysis
Ingredient safety data sourced from veterinary research, AAFCO guidelines, and toxicology databases

• Offline Access
Download the complete product database for scanning without internet

• Scan History
Keep track of products you've checked with notes and favorites

TRUSTED SOURCES:
Our ingredient analysis references AAFCO, FDA pet food regulations, ASPCA Animal Poison Control, Merck Veterinary Manual, and peer-reviewed research.

Note: PetScans provides educational information only and is not a substitute for professional veterinary advice.

Terms of service: https://petscans.app/terms

whatsNew:
